experiment: regating_truth_table: the re-gating side of the step-2 table (ratio, r, S for the 18 saved 67M runs), experiments/regating_truth_table/run.py. E-number given at run time (next free; E57 is Q3)
approval: decisions.md 2026-10-30, last row (Fable's advice reports/plans/2026-10-30_advice_regating-step2-FABLE.md item 2, taken by the lead): fill the table now, without labels; class 1 ($0, saved states)
filed: 2026-10-30, before any run; never edited after the run (a change is a dated amendment)
what_is_filed: the control rules (stage 0) and the expected values of the cells this job fills. The label predictions P1-P3 are NOT filed: see label_predictions
found_while_coding: Of the plan's 'not read' cells only one column is empty on disk. (1) E46's S is read on all eight runs (experiments/baseline_neurons/results/baseline_neurons.json b3, E52), not only ident32_s0 and rand32_s0. (2) r on E53's states is already in E53's saved cells: performed_anchor/run.py `cells` on the least-squares split state computes L01 - L00 (its 'g') and T1 - T0 (its 'G') by the same masked forward as local_faith.route_split (masked_lo_windows = masked_lo per window: masked_logits at the read position under the given gates, identity.log_odds of the target), so r = g / G, E12's definition. (3) The broad cipher's stand-in ratio is masked_gain / piece_gain of read_amend1b.json rows broad_cipher/s{0,1}/step300 (0.2852, 0.2729), read but not named a ratio in A1b's score. So the GPU reads only S on E53's six step-300 states, plus the stage-0 controls; every other cell is taken from the file named in 'table_sources'

settings.e53_windows: performed_anchor/run.py Run.scored: up to 500 windows of 127 tokens from Pile val rows 0-255, scored token at index 64, read at half = 63, target = each window's own next token (data.NEXT); lowercase pi = {}, cipher pi = a0.json's derangement (performed_anchor e53_pi), broad cipher pi = performed_anchor a1_maps()['broad_cipher'], asserted equal to check_amend1.json's map
settings.S: E52's B3 (steering.b3 via keydep.steer_reading) on the E53 windows: fit half = windows 0, 2, 4, ..., scoring half = 1, 3, 5, ...; one mean vector per block input (blocks 0-3) at the read position, the block chosen on the fit half (ties to the lower), S = its scoring-half share of G_score; G = mean over windows of log P_state(target) - log P_W0(target) at half (steering.gains)
settings.S_floor_source: E54 predictions.json settings floor_min (E52's): S is 'undefined' when |G_score| < 0.05; keydep's share_or_nan gives nan when |G_score| < 1e-6
settings.block0_nats_source: E54 stage 2's stop rule (keydependent_elicit/run.py): |S_block0 x G_score| <= 1e-5 nats on every read state; no fine-tune changes the embedding, so block 0's mean vector is 0 up to rounding
settings.stand_in_ratio_floor_source: E53 A1b thresholds floor_min: the ratio is 'undefined' when the subcomponent gain U1 - U0 < 0.1

stage0.order: first and alone; any miss writes results/stage0.json, logs FAIL and exits 1 before stage 1. The sha256 check runs before the model loads
stage0.sha256: every one of the 18 runs' state files and the two windows files read (E46 windows_ident32.pt, E54 windows_elicit.pt) equals the hash its source run recorded: E46 regating_table/results/stage0a.json (groups e12/<table>.states.s<i>.sha256, e12/build.sha256), E53 performed_anchor/results/finetune.json and finetune_amend1b.json (states <task>/s<i>/step300), E54 keydependent_elicit/results/stage2.json (finetunes) and stage1.json (sha256.elicit)
stage0.zero_update: G (steering.gains) of a zero delta-W on each task read (E46 ident32, E54 elicit, E53 lowercase, cipher, broad cipher) is 0 exactly (the same forward twice)

e53_lowercase_s0.reads: performed_anchor split_row (least-squares split, `cells`) of dW_lowercase_s0_step300.pt on E53's lowercase windows
e53_lowercase_s0.source: read_amend1b.json row e53/lowercase/s0/step300 (ratio masked_gain / piece_gain, G, r = g / G); tolerances E53 A1b/A2 repro_ratio_tol and repro_G_tol; r takes the ratio's tolerance (same call, same code)

e54_elicit_s0.reads: keydep.readings on E54's held-out elicit windows (as E54 stage 2)
e54_elicit_s0.source: keydependent_elicit/results/stage2.json states elicit_s0; tolerances E54 predictions.json stage0 r_tol, S_tol

e46_ident32_s0.reads: keydep.readings on E46's ident32 held-out windows (as E54 stage 0)
e46_ident32_s0.source: E54 predictions.json stage0 (r from regating_table stage0b.json, S from baseline_neurons.json b3); |S_block0| <= block0_tol as E54 stage 0

next_token_path.reads: the new path (steering with target data.NEXT on E53's windows, run.py NextTask) on dW_lowercase_s0_step300.pt: the full model's mean log-odds gain of the next token at half (steering.read with steering.logodds_at), and its block-0 share
next_token_path.G_logodds_ref: e53_lowercase_s0's G as read in this job by split_row
next_token_path.G_logodds_tol_source: E53 A2 repro_G_tol (its kl_read path against the split read, same windows, passed)

stage0.lean: all pass (E53 A2 and E54 stage 0 reproduced these numbers exactly or within 1e-3 with the same code)

stage1.reads: S (settings.S) on E53's six step-300 states: lowercase, cipher, broad_cipher x seeds 0, 1, each written to results/stage1.json and printed as it finishes. A state whose |S_block0 x G_score| exceeds block0_nats_tol stops the job (exit 1)
stage1.at_W0: G = 0 exactly (stage 0's zero update), so S is undefined (nan); block 0's share 0
stage1.do_nothing: steering never reads the decomposition: the do-nothing state (delta-W in Delta) has the fine-tune's target weights, so its S is the fine-tune's S. Not run
stage1.positive_control: E52's S on E46: copy 0.72-0.80 (four runs), random map 0.10-0.19 (four runs); E54: elicit 0.38 / 0.39, cipher 0.23 / 0.19. Stage 0 reproduces ident32_s0 and elicit_s0

lowercase.lean: medium: lowercasing the next word is one direction shared by every window (as copying is in E46, S 0.72-0.80), so one mean vector should carry most of it

cipher.lean: medium-high: a 50-word lookup cannot be one mean vector; E46's random maps read 0.10-0.19 and E54's cipher 0.19-0.23

broad_cipher.lean: medium-high: a 500-word lookup, less of it in any one direction than the 50-word cipher

order.rule: min over seeds of lowercase S > max over seeds of cipher and broad cipher S

stage1.use: reported, not scored and not a stop: a value outside its range is flagged 'outside_expected' in stage1.json and the log, and is reported as a surprise. Undefined (|G_score| < S_floor or nan) is reported as undefined, never as outside
stage1.noise_floor: S regenerates within 0.001 on the same state (E54 stage 0 against E52); seed spread on E46 0.03-0.08 (copy), 0.00-0.03 (random maps); E54 0.01-0.04
stage1.blind_to: S reads one mean vector at one position: a fine-tune that moves every window the same way reads high whether or not it reuses anything; it never reads the decomposition

table_sources.e46 (ident32, ident32b, rand32, rand32b;: ratio = gated_piece_gain / piece_gain of regating_table/results/amend3.json rows <table>/s<i> (E46 A3); r = stage0b.json states <table>/s<i> r; S = baseline_neurons.json b3 <table>_s<i> S (E52)
table_sources.e53 (lowercase, cipher; s0, s1): ratio = masked_gain / piece_gain and r = g / G of performed_anchor/results/read.json rows <task>/s<i>/step300; S = this job's stage1.json
table_sources.e53 broad_cipher (s0, s1): ratio and r as above from read_amend1b.json rows broad_cipher/s<i>/step300; S = stage1.json
table_sources.e54 (elicit, cipher at matched size; s0,: ratio = (L11 - L00) / (U1 - U0) of keydependent_elicit/results/stage2.json states <task>_s<i> cells (the planner's post-hoc reading, E53 A2); r, S = the same rows' r, S
table_sources.label_by_construction: copy, lowercase: reuses; random maps and every cipher: new; E54 elicit: open (plan table)
table_sources.expected_from_disk: ratio: E46 copy 0.87-0.97, random 0.36-0.41; E53 lowercase 0.919 / 0.929, cipher 0.264 / 0.257, broad cipher 0.285 / 0.273; E54 elicit 0.956 / 0.951, cipher 0.336 / 0.289. r: E46 copy 0.76-0.80, random 0.27-0.29; E53 lowercase 0.752 / 0.770, cipher 0.124 / 0.116, broad cipher 0.165 / 0.150; E54 0.773 / 0.758, 0.241 / 0.212. S: E46 as positive_control, E54 as positive_control

edge_cases_checked: S with G_score = 0: share_or_nan gives nan -> 'undefined', not 'outside_expected' (nan compares false with both range ends, so 'outside' is tested only on defined values)
S with 0 < |G_score| < 0.05: 'undefined' by S_floor, reported with its G
S negative or above 1: defined, compared with its range like any value
ties in B3's block choice: the lower block (steering.b3)

ratio with subcomponent gain < 0.1 or r with |G| < 1e-6 in a saved row: the table cell is 'undefined' with the parts beside it (none expected: the smallest subcomponent gain of the 18 runs is 1.4, the smallest |G| 1.6)
a source row missing: the table stops (KeyError) rather than leaving a silent gap

label_predictions.why: no label exists for any of the 18 runs (the reuse line's Stage B has not run; the open pair, experiments/open_pair, is a separate experiment). P1 (ranking AUC), P2 (the open runs) and P3 (beside steering) stay as written in the plan's 'Predictions (filed-style; not filed)' section and are filed, with the reuse line's run list and open marks, before any label is read; each rule is run on its edge cases then
